label: Illustrative AI output
callWith: Son Minh Nguyen, with a Vietnamese interpreter on standby for the member

transcript.speaker: Nurse
transcript.text: Hello, this is Maria, the nurse case manager with Pacific Harbor. Is this Minh? I'm calling about your mother. A Vietnamese interpreter is on the line if she'd like to join.

transcript.speaker: Son
transcript.text: Yes, this is Minh. I signed a release at Bay Oncology, if that's what you need.

transcript.speaker: Nurse
transcript.text: Thank you, I'll get a copy for our file. The nurse line told us she had a fever Saturday night. How is she right now?

transcript.speaker: Son
transcript.text: It was 38.3 with chills. I called the oncologist's on-call line and they said to watch it and call back if it went up. It was about 37.8 this morning.

transcript.speaker: Nurse
transcript.text: So she didn't go to the emergency room?

transcript.speaker: Nurse
transcript.text: Has she had the nausea medicine from Dr. Lin?

transcript.speaker: Son
transcript.text: No. The pharmacy on Tully Road closed, so we never got it. She's barely eating. I've been making rice soup before my shift.

transcript.speaker: Son
transcript.text: CVS on Story Road. That's where her other medicines come from.

transcript.speaker: Nurse
transcript.text: And the rides for the 16th and 17th?

transcript.speaker: Son
transcript.text: The driver went to the wrong building last time. It's Tully Road, apartment 206, ZIP 95122. I missed a shift to drive her.

transcript.speaker: Nurse
transcript.text: How has she been feeling in herself?

transcript.speaker: Son
transcript.text: She cries sometimes, I think. Maybe when I'm at work? My wife would know better.
